payload.summary: Teaching Assessments: wire durable authenticated assessment storage and supervisor bookings (follow-up to #4KQGXZ)
payload.detail: The schema, RLS policies and migration for registrar assessments exist, but the dual-sign-off route still uses in-process memory and returns 503 in production, and no supervisor-booking endpoints or availability storage exist. Wire durable authenticated storage into the route and add the booking endpoints before closing.
